Alpha.name: NumberEEGChannels
Alpha.tooltip: How many EEG Channels do you need? It needs to be the same as in actiCHamp LSL Connector.

Alpha.name: ReferenceChannel
Alpha.tooltip: Which Channel should be used as Refernece?

Alpha.name: TriggerChannel
Alpha.tooltip: ActiCHamp input the trigger cable is plugged into, counted over all amplifier inputs: 1-32 are the EEG inputs, 33 = AUX 1, 34 = AUX 2, and so on. It does not depend on how many EEG channels you record: trigger in AUX 1 -> enter 33. This is not the column number in the saved file (there the trigger follows the recorded EEG channels).

Alpha.name: Trigger
Alpha.tooltip: Fixed: The acoustic trigger occurs after the chosen time. External: The trigger is connected to the EEG amplifier.

Alpha.name: Start
Alpha.tooltip: Does the Subject has the eyes closed or open at the beginning of the measurement? ONLY FOR EYES CLOSED IMPLEMENTED!!

Alpha.name: Label
Alpha.tooltip: Do you analyse the Alpha power, attention or stress?
